desc: Ideation & correctness proof: G = complement of interval overlap graph; components are either all-connected (cut exists) or isolated vertices (overlap all others) plus one big component; diameter ≤ 3 within big component; answer formula validated on both samples (11/6/-1 and 157/124/-1/114/114).

Implement full Python solution with fast I/O: sorted-by-R prefix minima, sorted-by-L suffix minima, A_v per vertex, iso flags, has_cut sweep, per-query O(1) answer using the formula; guard INF cases; enclose code in required delimiters.
